messages:
Arjun: Quick sync  coordinating with SQLMesh (SI) + Databricks Unity Catalog + Qdrant for a marketplace preview. Goal: minimal friction onboarding for customers using Delta Share + Unity, plus a short SI playbook.
Leah: Thanks Arjun. Key constraints: Unity Catalog RBAC model + Delta Share ACLs. Need a reproducible sample and an explicit metadata mapping for Qdrant payloads.
Carmen: Marketing asks for a one-pager + 90s demo. Can we promise a masked sample by EOD Tue? Also, partner branding needs approval lead time.
Ben: Infra notes: will run a 48h soak on Aurora nodes and a 24h quantized path check on DGX. Need firmware minimums from Aurora team (likely fw>=1.12). I'll post the matrix.
Arjun: Proposed micro-timeline:
- Day 0: confirm partner PMs & start logo approvals
- Day 1: upload masked sample to partner-test bucket
- Day 3: CI run (Delta Share -> Unity consumer -> vectorize -> Qdrant upsert)
- Day 5: infra soak + perf capture (p50/p95/p99)
- Day 7: dry-run + embargo lock
- Day 8: publish certified-badge listing (fast path)
Leah: Decision point: combined bundle vs "Certified Connector" badge. Ops + legal favor badge to avoid revenue-share delays. Marketing prefers combined for co-marketing but can start with badge.
Partner Ops Bot: Logo approval requested to Databricks and Qdrant at 2026-05-12T10:30Z. Status: pending.
Carmen: Marketing will prepare assets but requests a 7 business-day lead for co-branded materials. I'll draft the demo storyboard this afternoon.
Ben: Infra action items:
- Validate Aurora firmware >=1.12, post compatibility matrix
- Soak: 48h on Aurora staging pool, measure p99 under 1k concurrent queries
- DGX: run quantized path with batch sizes 1/4/8, check memory usage
ETA: initial results in ~48h after sample upload.
Arjun: CI snippet to include in repo README (please review):
```
name: delta-unity-qdrant-ci
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
      - name: Run integration
        env:
          SAMPLE_BUCKET: ${{ secrets.SAMPLE_BUCKET }}
        run: python tests/integration/run_delta_to_qdrant.py --bucket "$SAMPLE_BUCKET"
```
Leah: Also add a schema manifest (manifest.yaml) with expected payload fields for Qdrant filters. We'll validate manifest in CI. Carmen, can marketing avoid showing exact latency numbers in the demo?
Carmen: Yes, will avoid numeric claims until infra soak finalizes. We'll show qualitative messaging ("low-latency retrieval").
Partner Ops Bot: Action created: "sqlmesh-unity-qdrant-triage" assigned to Arjun, due 2026-05-20T23:59:00Z.
SRE Bot: CI job scheduled: connectors/ci/delta-unity-qdrant-matrix. Artifacts will be uploaded on failure.
Ben: One gotcha: Qdrant requires consistent payload key names for filter queries. Add a lightweight adapter that normalizes column names from Unity -> Qdrant payload. I'll add a unit test for it.
Leah: Legal: can we get EU residency / dataflow attestation by EOD tomorrow? Need it before logo approvals go final.
Arjun: I'll ping legal separately. Also recommend we include an opt-in telemetry flag for soak (anonymized traces) so partners are comfortable. Legal + privacy signoff needed.
Carmen: SI enablement plan: 60m webinar, quickstart repo, troubleshooting cheatsheet. SQLMesh will run an internal dry-run with their SI engineers before partner dry-run.
Ben: I'll post firmware + perf matrix once soak starts. If any incompatibilities, we fallback to non-optimized kernel path and mark performance caveats in the playbook.
Leah: Final request: add a short rollback checklist for listing (unpublish, disable marketplace feature-flag, open emergency channel). Carmen will draft customer comms templates.
Arjun: Thanks everyone. I'll fold this into the triage doc and loop partner PMs after legal confirms EU residency. Quick sync Fri 9:30am PT if needed.
Carmen: Thanks ":thumbsup:"
Ben: End of thread.
